dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。本日は、ご相談にお越し下さり、ありがとうございます。よろしければ、始めに年齢、性別、ご相談内容をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. If you're comfortable, could you please start by telling me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 40歳女です
dialogue.English: I'm a 40-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 夫との関係性で、悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with my relationship with my husband.

dialogue.content: コミュニケーションがうまく取れず苛立ったり話したくなくなったりします
dialogue.English: We can't communicate well, which makes me irritated and sometimes I don't want to talk at all.

dialogue.content: お話下さり、ありがとうございます。そうなのですね。もう少し詳しくお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. I see. Could you please tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: 今は夫の考え方や話す言葉言い方全てがいやです
dialogue.English: Right now, I dislike everything about the way he thinks, the words he uses, and his tone.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そのように感じられているのですね。嫌だという感情は、相談者さん自身もお疲れになられますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand—that's how you're feeling. Carrying that sense of dislike can be exhausting for you as well, can't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仕事から帰ってきてほしくない気持ちになります
dialogue.English: I find myself not wanting him to come home from work.

dialogue.content: 配偶者の方とは、どのようなお話をされる時に、特にいやだとお感じになられますか？
dialogue.English: When you talk with your spouse, what kinds of conversations make you feel particularly upset?

dialogue.content: 行き違いになり、失礼致しました。なるほど、そうなのですね。会わない方がいやな気持ちにならないですものね。
dialogue.English: My apologies, we seem to have missed each other's messages. I see, that makes sense. It's true that you wouldn't have to feel upset if you didn't see him.

dialogue.content: どんな話、、、どんな種類の話でも、反応や返してくる言動が思いもよらぬ方向になっていることがいやでし
dialogue.English: Any kind of conversation... whatever the topic, I dislike how his reactions and responses go in completely unexpected directions.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。思いもよらぬ方向になってしまうと、会話が成り立たないようなお気持ちになってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. When things go in such unexpected directions, it must feel like you can't even have a proper conversation.

dialogue.content: はい。否定的な言い方や反応、表情、、、本当にきらいです
dialogue.English: Yes. His negative tone, reactions, and expressions... I truly hate them.

dialogue.content: そのようにお感じなのですね。そのような否定的な反応が返ってくると、きらいだとお感じになるのはとても自然なことと思います。
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel. It's completely natural to feel that way when you receive such negative responses.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、お話し頂き、ありがとうございます。ここでは、どんなことでもお話し下さって大丈夫ですので、心配せずお話し下さいね。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for talking with me. Please know that you can talk about anything here, so don't worry and please speak freely.

dialogue.content: ありがたいです
dialogue.English: I appreciate that.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんは、きっとこれまでいやな気持ち、きらいな気持ちを抱えて、ずっと我慢してこられたのではないかと感じます。
dialogue.English: I get the sense that you've been holding in these feelings of dislike and frustration, and have been enduring it for a very long time.

dialogue.content: 子どももいるので我慢は続きます
dialogue.English: I have children, so I'll have to keep enduring it.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、お子様がいらっしゃるのですね。おいくつぐらいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you have children. How old are they, if you don't mind me asking?

dialogue.content: 9さいと6さいです
dialogue.English: They are nine and six.

dialogue.content: なるほど、お二人とも小学生でいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are they both in elementary school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。相談者さんは、配偶者の方の言動の、お子さんへの影響もご心配なのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. I imagine you might also be concerned about the impact of your spouse's words and actions on your children?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, I am.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それはご自身のことだけではないからこそ、ご心配も増しておられるのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. I imagine that because it's not just about you, your worries are even greater.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのとおりです
dialogue.English: That's exactly right.

dialogue.content: お子さんへの配偶者の方への関わり方は、ご相談者さんから見られていかがですか？
dialogue.English: From your perspective, how does your spouse interact with your children?

dialogue.content: 大変失礼致しました。「お子さんへの配偶者の方の関わり方」の間違いです。
dialogue.English: My sincerest apologies. I meant to ask, 'how your spouse interacts with your children'.

dialogue.content: 否定的ないやな言い方をしたりします
dialogue.English: He speaks to them in a negative, unpleasant way.

dialogue.content: なるほど、相談者さんへの態度とよく似た言い方、という感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So would you say it's a similar tone to how he speaks to you?

dialogue.content: でも、子どもたちは父親を求めているので奪うことはできない
dialogue.English: But my children need their father, so I can't take him away from them.

dialogue.content: 行き違いすみません
dialogue.English: Sorry for the crossed messages.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうお感じなのですね。お子様方にとっては、たった一人の大切なお父様ですものね。
dialogue.English: I see, that's how you feel. For your children, he is their one and only precious father, after all.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、こちらこそ失礼致しました。どうぞ相談者さんの話しやすいペースでお話下さいね。
dialogue.English: Not at all, my apologies as well. Please, speak at a pace that is comfortable for you.

dialogue.content: だからこそ私の我慢が膨れている感じです
dialogue.English: That's precisely why my frustration keeps building up.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 子どもたちが成人したら離れるという選択肢も考えていますが、遠すぎて、、、
dialogue.English: I've considered the option of separating once the children are adults, but that feels so far away...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。相談者さんは、配偶者の方に、これまでご自身で何か伝えたことはありますか？きっとこれまで色々な努力をされてきたと思うのですが、よろしければお聴かせ下さいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you ever tried to communicate your feelings to your spouse? I'm sure you've made many efforts so far, and I'd like to hear about them if you're willing to share.

dialogue.content: 伝えてみたりあゆみ寄ってみたり、喜ぶことをしてみたり
dialogue.English: I've tried telling him, I've tried meeting him halfway, and I've tried doing things that would make him happy.

dialogue.content: 関係性が良くなるようなこてをしてみました
dialogue.English: I've tried things to improve our relationship.

dialogue.content: でも、すぐに元に戻ってしまう感じでした
dialogue.English: But it always felt like things would go right back to how they were.

dialogue.content: なるほど、相談者さんの思いつくことを色々してこられたのですね。とても努力されていると思います。先ほどお話し下さった、お子様方が成人したらと考えるには遠いというお話も、そう感じられて当然のことと思います。
dialogue.English: I see, so you've tried all sorts of things you could think of. I believe you've made a great effort. And regarding what you said earlier about waiting until the children are adults feeling too far away—it's completely understandable that you'd feel that way.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。それは絶望するようなお気持ちも感じられたのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have made you feel a sense of despair.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 立ち直るのが本当につらいでさ
dialogue.English: It's so hard to recover from it.

dialogue.content: です
dialogue.English: It is.

dialogue.content: よく耐えられていますね。お子様のお気持ちを大事にされているからこそだと思います。
dialogue.English: You are enduring so much. I believe it's because you cherish your children's feelings.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: なるほど、いやなお気持ちから立ち直るのに、エネルギーがかなり必要だという感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So it sounds like it takes a significant amount of energy to recover from these unpleasant feelings?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 子どもたちに気づかれたくないのもありますし、、
dialogue.English: And I also don't want the children to notice...

dialogue.content: なるほど。いやな気持ちは、その瞬間だけではないですものね。そこから自分をケアして元の状態に戻るまで、とても大変だと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. The unpleasant feeling doesn't just last for a moment, does it? I imagine it's very difficult to take care of yourself and get back to your usual state after that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ（どうぞ続けて下さいね）
dialogue.English: Yes, please go on.

dialogue.content: 立ち直るまた試す元に戻ってしまうを繰り返してるだけです
dialogue.English: I'm just repeating the cycle of recovering, trying again, and then things go right back to how they were.

dialogue.content: 何年も同じ場所にいるかがします
dialogue.English: It feels like I've been in the same place for years.

dialogue.content: 気がします
dialogue.English: That's how it feels.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。繰り返しているだけとお話し下さいましたが、実はそれが非常に大変なことだと私は思いますよ。元のご自身にどんなときでも戻されて、こうして相談にお越しくださったこと、私はとてもすごいことだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. You say you're just repeating the cycle, but I think what you're doing is actually incredibly difficult. The fact that you always manage to pull yourself back together and have come here to talk today—I think that's truly amazing.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 何年もそれを繰り返して悩んでこられたのですね。本当に大変だったと思います。
dialogue.English: You've been wrestling with this cycle for many years. It must have been truly difficult.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ここまでお話を伺って、相談者さんはできることをたくさん試されてきたけれど、配偶者の方が変わられない絶望も感じられている中で、お子様方のためにできない我慢も続けられていますね。
dialogue.English: From what I've heard so far, it seems you've tried many things you could. Yet, amid the despair you feel that your spouse won't change, you continue to endure what feels unbearable for your children's sake.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 配偶者の方の言動でお子様方へも影響があるようですが、離れることは今は難しいとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: It seems your spouse's words and actions are also affecting your children, but do you feel that leaving him is difficult right now?

dialogue.content: 子どもたちは悲しむと思うので
dialogue.English: Because I think the children would be sad.

dialogue.content: ええ（どうぞ続けて下さいね）
dialogue.English: Yes, please go on.

dialogue.content: 今は離れない方がいいと思っています
dialogue.English: For now, I think it's better not to separate.

dialogue.content: そうお考えなのですね。ちなみに、お子様方は配偶者の方をどう思っているか、お話になられたことはありますか？（お子様の状況をお伺いできれば、と思っただけなので、離れることを無理におすすめするつもりではありませんので、ご安心下さいね。）
dialogue.English: I see that's your view. By the way, have you ever talked with your children about how they feel about their father? (I'm only asking to better understand the children's situation; I'm not trying to push you toward separation, so please don't worry.)

dialogue.content: 子どもたちは父親を求めているし、好きです
dialogue.English: My children need their father, and they love him.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それは、離れると子どもたちが心を痛めるだろうとお考えになるのはもっともなことだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, it's very reasonable for you to think that separating would cause your children pain.

dialogue.content: 息子は、同性もあり本当に必要なんだなと感じます
dialogue.English: My son, being the same gender, I feel he really needs him.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。相談者さんが、離れないことを選ばれている理由がわかります。
dialogue.English: I understand. I can see why you're choosing not to separate.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お子様の目線に立って、愛情深い選択をされていると思います。ですが、相談者さんが少しでも楽になられる方法を見つけたいですね。何か、今の状態の中でもできそうなことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I believe you are making a very loving choice from your children's perspective. However, I'd like to help you find a way to make things a little easier for yourself. Is there anything you feel you could do within the current situation?

dialogue.content: 離れるのは簡単ですが、代償が大食い気がしています、、、
dialogue.English: Leaving is easy, but I feel the price to pay would be enormous...

dialogue.content: すみませ
dialogue.English: Sorry.

dialogue.content: 代償が大きい
dialogue.English: The cost would be great.

dialogue.content: 今出来そうなことは
dialogue.English: As for what I could do now...

dialogue.content: ええ（どうぞ続けて下さいね）
dialogue.English: Yes, please continue.

dialogue.content: 別居かなー
dialogue.English: Maybe living separately.

dialogue.content: 離れたい人離れたくない人が自由に自分で選べるといいなと考えてます
dialogue.English: I think it would be good if those who want to separate and those who don't can freely choose for themselves.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そのような方法もありますね。先ほどお話し頂いた「代償」は、別居の形ですと、少しは小さくなりそうですか？
dialogue.English: I see—that is one option. If you were to live apart, do you think the "cost" you mentioned earlier might be somewhat smaller?

dialogue.content: たぶん
dialogue.English: Probably.

dialogue.content: なるほど。家族がそれぞれご自分の選択ができるということですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. So each family member could make their own choice.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 実現したいと思っています
dialogue.English: I'd like to make that happen.

dialogue.content: お聴かせ頂き、ありがとうございます。相談者さんが出して下さった「別居」という案は、とても現実的で、家族みなさまのお気持ちを考えられていると感じます。まだお話を続けたいのですが、今日はお時間になりましたので、もしまた続きをお話しになりたい時は、記録を残しておきますので、またお越しいただいてもよろしいでしょうか？大事なお話の途中なのに、申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. The idea you proposed—living apart—feels very practical and considerate of everyone in the family's feelings. I would like to continue our conversation, but we're out of time for today. If you'd like to continue this discussion, I will keep a record of our session, so would you be open to coming back again? I'm very sorry to have to stop in the middle of such an important conversation.

dialogue.content: はい。今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、大変なお気持ちを話して下さり、ありがとうございました。またいつでもお待ちしておりますので、お一人で抱え込まず、気持ちを吐き出すだけでも構いませんので、気軽にお越しくださいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for sharing such difficult feelings. I'll be here for you anytime, so please don't feel you have to bear this alone. Feel free to come back anytime, even if it's just to vent.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。それでは、本日の相談を終わらせて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. With that, I'll conclude today's session.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.
